issue.title: Obsidian Task Card relation-label stage flips direction on ~ like the Mac label card

task_type_fields.proposal:
In the Obsidian Task Card relation-label stage (bob-plugins), a choose-mode `~` should flip the pending relation between Links to and Linked from, as the Bob Mac Capture relation label card does since bob-cli-hz.1 (bob-mac-capture cbb50dc). The flip should edit the pending token (`~note:id` <-> `~~note:id`), update the stage sentence, re-ask Bob for the label catalog and the cancel/complete/successor verdicts for the new direction, and keep the query, selection, one-off, and Hidden state. Stale verdicts or candidates from the old direction must never commit. Rename mode keeps `~` as text. Labels can never contain `~`, so the key is free in choose mode.

Evidence: bob-plugins docs/task-card.md (master 2563c78) documents `~` flipping only in the Links to / Linked from picker filter (`l` / `Shift+L` rows). Its relation-label stage rows (Ctrl+R rename, Ctrl+D hide, Ctrl+H Hidden section) have no flip key. Likely code homes: plugins/bob-navigation-hotkeys/src/429-relation-label-management.js, 450-picker-keydown.js, 410-picker-filter-and-render.js, and plugins/bob-ledger-tools/src/172-plugin-relation-labels.js. Reference behavior: bob-mac-capture docs/relationship-pickers.md (relation label card section) and decisions:relation-equals-alias-and-flips. The `=` alias and the fast `==` escape are Mac-only and out of scope here; the plan asks only for `~`.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The bob-cli-hz epic plan (plan:202611/relation_equals_alias_and_direction_flips.md, "Settled points") put the Obsidian Task Card label stage explicitly out of scope and told its records phase to file this parity follow-up. bob-cli-hz.5 recorded it as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #1 without filing it; the bob-cli-hz lander is filing it here.

issue.creation_reason: The bob-cli-hz plan made Obsidian label-stage parity out of scope and asked for a follow-up bead; bob-cli-hz.5 proposed it (note #1) and the hz lander files it.
